method: The original runs did not record stop reasons. Stored texts were re-tokenised with the same T5 tokenizer; a text at 128 tokens or ending without sentence-final punctuation is marked cap/incomplete, otherwise eos. A15 was generated with return_dict_in_generate and has exact stop reasons.
note: A selected train-r4 is the only cap; its f3/f4 omissions must not be counted as normal post-EOS omissions.
